lax special functions

Source: R/lax_special.R
lax_special.Rd

Ports of the special functions of jax.lax: the regularized incomplete beta integral (lax_betainc), the regularized incomplete gamma functions and their derivatives (lax_igamma, lax_igammac, lax_igamma_grad_a, lax_random_gamma_grad), the polygamma and Hurwitz zeta functions and the exponentially scaled modified Bessel functions of order 0 and 1. Arguments must be floating point arrays with equal dtypes (R scalars adopt the dtype of the other arguments).

Usage

lax_betainc(a, b, x)

lax_polygamma(m, x)

lax_igamma(a, x)

lax_igammac(a, x)

lax_igamma_grad_a(a, x)

lax_random_gamma_grad(a, x)

lax_zeta(x, q)

lax_bessel_i0e(x)

lax_bessel_i1e(x)

Arguments

a, b, x, m, q

Arrays.

Value

An array.
